summary: KubeCoderDeploy terraform/ declares the zpool5 dataset and local PV inline (static-zfs-pv's attributes, prevent_destroy), with stage inputs and manage_webhook (true in dev only) in config/{dev,prd}/terraform.tfvars, plus the repo's github_repository_webhook to the relay, signed with var.github_webhook_secret. tests/terraform.sh (fmt, validate, a mocked-provider terraform test per stage) joins the gate; kc project test and lint are green, landed as 9d6c448 on phase/010-P5.
